concerns.text: The specification (FR‑008) requires a linear regression analysis with heteroscedasticity‑robust standard errors for each topology‑performance pair, yet the plan only describes Spearman correlation, partial correlation, and permutation testing. Absence of the mandated regression step means the analysis will not satisfy the spec’s regression reporting requirement.

The plan states an a‑priori power analysis targeting ≥ 60 % power to detect ρ = 0.3, but later computes a Minimum Detectable Effect Size (MDES) for 80 % power. This inconsistency creates ambiguity about which power target governs the exploratory flag and may lead to contradictory conclusions about study feasibility.
